payload.compatibility_note: exact: unknown fields reject; any field/type/value change breaks the digest and requires a new schema version, never a silent reinterpretation.

identity.hash_rule: sha256 over RFC 8785 canonical bytes of the payload object WITHOUT digest; the index is not an alternate authority (full canonical row validation precedes cache admission)
